owner_authorization.source: Direct owner instruction in the audit conversation on 2026-10-04
permitted: Repair evidence-backed defects on the separate working branch
Run code-only, host-widget and isolated PostgreSQL tests
Create a dedicated Google reviewer account with an official administrative gift
Verify the existing Apple reviewer without changing that account
Reconcile actual store declarations to current source
Prepare technical contracts and evidence documents
Create clean commits and non-force GitHub pushes
Publish current public static disclosures and link contracts without mobile builds or Worker bundling
not_permitted: Any mobile application build, signed or unsigned
TestFlight, Play or App Store upload or submission
Protected release branch or frozen-manifest changes
History rewrite, force push, implementation rollback or revert
Fake purchases, entitlements, counters, notifications or reviewer bypasses
Application-table grants to manufacture passing tests
Signing legal owner declarations on the owner's behalf

must_precede_apply: Targeted staging QA succeeds for the exact committed candidate
Candidate staging QA succeeds for the exact committed candidate
must_follow_apply: Focused Production role-authenticated RPC assertions inside a rolled-back transaction; not Auth-service HTTP login, native E2E or provider delivery
Security, grants, RLS, Storage and performance-advisor refresh

evidence_boundaries.local_sql: Genuine candidate RPCs, live dependency snapshots, ordinary roles and overlapping PostgreSQL17.11 sessions; Production is PostgreSQL17.6, and this is not Production, Auth-service login, provider delivery or Storage HTTP transport
evidence_boundaries.reviewer_host_widgets: Ordinary Production authentication and server entitlement/credits with genuine route widgets; not a native store transaction or device sign-in
evidence_boundaries.store_backend_contracts: Mocked backend/provider contracts do not establish real StoreKit or Google Play Billing purchases
evidence_boundaries.visual_tests: Host layouts and explicit locales/scales only; not native font equivalence or missing original reference images
evidence_boundaries.secret_inventory: Presence of secret names is not certificate validity or signed-artifact evidence

signatures.source_commit: Use the eventual GitHub commit identity and exact SHA; not an owner legal signature

decision_rule: Any unresolved release-critical defect or unproved mandatory release boundary means NOT READY FOR BUILD
